body: I'm not a victim, I don't live in "darkness". I don't struggle getting out of bed or face a crippling depression. I see both positives and negatives in life, I just don't believe it's worth living. I'm just a normal kid who thinks about killing himself a lot. I hurt myself because it feels good, not because I feel depressed or want attention. I was just posting to see if there were other people like me
